blocks.html:
This method retrieves a notification's details. It sends a request to the 
[Get Notification](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#notifications\_getnotificationsid)
API route.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the notification.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: to
children.description:
The identifier the notification is sent to.
For example, an email, phone number, or username.

children.name: channel
children.description: The channel to send the notification through.

children.name: template
children.description:
A template ID to use for the notification's content.

For example, the ID of a template in SendGrid.

children.name: data
children.description: Data to pass to the template.

children.name: resource_id
children.description:
The ID of the associated resource. for example, if the notification was triggered 
because an order was created, this would be the ID of the order.

children.name: resource_type
children.description: The type of the resource that triggered the notification.

children.name: receiver_id
children.description: The ID of the user or customer that received the notification.

children.name: original_notification_id
children.description: The ID of the original notification if this is a resend of it.

children.name: external_id
children.description: The ID of the notification in an external or third-party system.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: The ID of the notification provider used.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the notification was created.
